description: This PHP source file defines the 'Page' class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing the content and behavior related to website pages such as retrieving, listing, validating, and saving page data.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: A class representing a website page, with methods to retrieve, list, validate, save, and parse page content.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a page by ID, optionally considering language, returns a Page object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all pages with optional filters and language considerations, returns an array of Page objects.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a simple list of pages, typically used for dropdowns or quick references.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current Page object's data, reports errors if required fields are missing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the Page object into the database, returning success or failure.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Converts markdown content to HTML if the page is of type 'md', otherwise returns raw content.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new Page record into the database.
